# Devgram
Location · `loc_fc0c95c50b65` · proposed
Also called: Himalayan village, village, gaon

Notes marked [proposed] are unreviewed.

## Constraints
- [proposed] Prosperity must be depicted through maintained roofs, repaired walls, stocked grain rooms, and clean shared spaces, with absolutely no visual clutter, large houses, or luxury vehicles. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.5: "It does not mean large houses, luxury vehicles or visual clutter.")_ <!-- note_6a0040fbcb0e -->
- [proposed] No street movement occurs anywhere at night; all villagers go indoors after the evening bell. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.10: "NIGHT DOMESTIC Food, stories, radios, study; no street movement")_ <!-- note_ca378d619c98 -->
- [proposed] At twilight, a bell signals a strict curfew where all outdoor areas must be completely empty of people until morning. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.12: "nobody remains outside until morning.")_ <!-- note_5ab4373e6691 -->
- [proposed] Rain must begin falling across the village immediately after the visual transgression at the temple, feeling like natural weather before taking on a judgmental atmosphere. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.26: "Begins after the visual transgression. It should feel meteorological before it feels judgmental.")_ <!-- note_aaf5ede3a0fc -->

## Description
- [proposed] A prosperous Himalayan village characterized by the constant, steady sound of the river. _(Dehleez_Episode_1_Screenplay_Draft.pdf p.2: "The steady sound of a river. A huge temple bell rings across a prosperous Himalayan village.")_ <!-- note_d49547f20ad2 -->
- [proposed] The village is built entirely on the north bank of a steep river gorge, with orchard terraces rising behind the houses and raw rock visible everywhere. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.5: "settlement on the north bank... Orchard terraces rise behind the houses")_ <!-- note_fc4e98640511 -->
- [proposed] The village appears prosperous through well-maintained physical structures and functional shared spaces, rather than displaying commercial or flashy wealth. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.11: "wealth is stored in maintained things, available people and the absence of constant urgency.")_ <!-- note_adf228b48cc3 -->
- [proposed] The entire village voluntarily shuts down, emptying completely of people and activity after the evening bell rings. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.22: "A prosperous place voluntarily disappears")_ <!-- note_9763849b8493 -->
- [proposed] The village is situated on the north bank of the river, opposite the temple on the south bank. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.28: "Village on north bank; temple on south bank")_ <!-- note_fdd572c37274 -->

## Reference images
### Terrain
- [proposed] Modern Infrastructure in Green Gorges — A wide, fast-flowing river cuts through the bottom of a deep, dramatic gorge, flanked by steep, heavily forested green hillsides. A massive steel arch bridge spans the immense gap high above the water under a bright, clear sky. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/a22415f3b760b5027025836b0004c46ef7635a275d359141aeb16fc3a9cb0836/original.jpg` _(James McCauley from Enon, OH, United States of America, upload by Herrick, CC BY 2.0 <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:New_River_Gorge_Bridge_West_Virginia_244750516.jpg>)_ <!-- note_e663c5c5570f -->
- [proposed] Modern Infrastructure in Green Gorges — A wide river cuts through the bottom of a deep, dramatic gorge flanked by steep, heavily forested hillsides. A massive steel arch bridge spans the immense gap high above the water under a bright, cloudy sky. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/b4a8d124ababa981f3dcd051ee7888ec073cb937c9d75bafed3472e5efb02ae5/original.jpg` _(Gr33n Wiki, CC BY-SA 4.0 <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:New_River_Gorge_Bridge,_W_VA.jpg>)_ <!-- note_28ff06716aba -->
- [proposed] Modern Infrastructure in Green Gorges — A deep, dramatic gorge is flanked by steep, heavily forested green hillsides. A massive steel arch bridge spans the immense gap high above a thick layer of white mist beneath a partly cloudy sky. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/353ed82f09bd10e4c3fd4f320849a5ea79ce4e4d3f961ba27252dd37d71859a7/original.jpg` _(NewRiverBridge West virginia.jpg, Public domain <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:NewRiverBridge_West_virginia.jpg>)_ <!-- note_8290d08522f9 -->
- [proposed] Vertical Stepped Orchard Terraces — A steep mountainside is heavily layered with stepped, green orchard terraces and wooden trellises. Weathered stone buildings dot the sheer slope, which climbs toward a cluster of bright white structures at the sunlit summit. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/60c45c4506770af71500bb4f7674c6de275ad017b66841a25b255d86b69fbf55/original.jpg` _(Jensens, Public domain <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lemon_orchard_Amalfi.jpg>)_ <!-- note_83ee72e05337 -->
- [proposed] Vertical Stepped Orchard Terraces — Bare, flowering trees stand on narrow, stepped terraces cut into a steep hillside under a partly cloudy sky. The terraces are held back by sturdy retaining walls constructed from rough, dry-laid grey stones. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/0f697429b5410e513a17ceb66b6727af20cad9dad578a497717309e4c3b24ac8/original.jpg` _(Joanbanjo, CC BY-SA 3.0 <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ametllers_florits_al_pla_de_Petracos,_Castell_de_Castells.jpg>)_ <!-- note_c7c0d3311d45 -->
- [proposed] Stark Barren River Gorges — A dramatic, steep-sided river gorge cuts through rugged, mountainous terrain under heavy clouds. The stark, barren slopes plunge down toward the valley floor, demonstrating the immense scale and verticality of the landscape. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/0e54cab89a69eda0b665767226811462fb03caebdae4842664cf52bda286667d/original.jpg` _(Theo10011, CC BY-SA 4.0 <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kinnaur_valley.jpg>)_ <!-- note_bb3b1a617811 -->

### Architecture
- [proposed] Traditional Stone and Slate Architecture — A multi-tiered tower constructed with alternating horizontal bands of timber and stone sits beneath a steep, snow-dusted mountain slope. The striking traditional structure is surrounded by smaller buildings with pitched roofs under an overcast winter sky. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/dc8049a5584a2db524a401c9bf11dc24239ec7dbaded1c395f172f7d9f9f9679/original.jpg` _(Vishesh luck, CC BY-SA 4.0 <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bhimakali_temple,_Sarahan_Bushahr,_Shimla,_HP.jpg>)_ <!-- note_60bcb805949c -->

### Material
- [proposed] Traditional Stone and Slate Architecture — Low, rough-hewn dry stone walls support heavy, irregular roofs made of thick, overlapping slate slabs in bright daylight. A distant, sparsely vegetated hill rises behind these sturdy, windowless structures, highlighting the heavily textured traditional building materials. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/872293e772e34ba4db20607e17e574d5360f21de1f3b3edf1e23f2c0e47bbd1b/original.jpg` _(No machine-readable author provided. João Carvalho assumed (based on copyright claims)., CC BY-SA 3.0 <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ermelo_01.JPG>)_ <!-- note_ddcb6d35439f -->
- [proposed] Traditional Stone and Slate Architecture — A person sits on wooden planks across a steeply pitched roof, installing thick, overlapping slate tiles. The broad roof surface highlights the irregular edges and varied textures of the dark grey slates in bright daylight. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/8c47ed230fc122b8aaa98b21ea223667a2a166685050302e6ab9ea1bbd3384f6/original.jpg` _(Karora, Public domain <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Slater_at_work,_Rothesay,_Isle_of_Bute.jpg>)_ <!-- note_25bf8c0ee4b3 -->
- [proposed] Traditional Stone and Slate Architecture — A sturdy, windowless outbuilding stands in an open grassy area, its walls constructed entirely from rough, dry-laid grey stone. The highly textured, irregular masonry demonstrates traditional dry stone building techniques. — `gs://film-harness-memory/projects/prj_811abbb21145/sources/1ced85a53ba64d905cbdb510a27b91294ff67916824a04fe3afe20eed4d5f4c8/original.jpg` _(Eddylandzaat, CC BY-SA 3.0 nl <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Old_shed_with_dry_stone_masonry_in_Cloonbony_Milltown_Malbay.jpg>)_ <!-- note_2a666483e912 -->

## Only during these scenes
_True while the scene plays, not the place's usual state._

### 7 · 7. INT./EXT. PANDIT'S DREAM - NIGHT
- [proposed] The protector dreams of the river rapidly rising and completely swallowing the village, accompanied by a voice saying 'This is your time to talk to me.' _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.4: "The protector dreams of the river swallowing Devgram.")_ <!-- note_81a3a215714a -->
- [proposed] The entire village is completely empty at dawn. _(Dehleez_Episode_1_Screenplay_Draft.pdf p.13: "DREAM: Devgram at dawn. Empty.")_ <!-- note_2b8038ea96a4 -->
- [proposed] A solitary man's hand reaches upward from beneath the surface of the village floodwater. _(Dehleez_Episode_1_Screenplay_Draft.pdf p.13: "Beneath the floodwater, a man’s hand reaches upward.")_ <!-- note_0895ce55d61b -->

## Project-wide
- [proposed] The material palette across the production must be limited to grey river stone, dark timber, mud and lime plaster, slate roofs, worn brass, wool, cotton, orchard greens, sandalwood red, and cold turquoise water. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.5: "Grey river stone, dark timber, mud and lime plaster, slate roofs, worn brass")_ <!-- note_ac6c63b78d4f -->
- [proposed] The visual grammar must shift from longer lenses with frames broken by doorways on Day One to wider lenses permitting shared, uninterrupted spaces on Day Two. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.26: "Longer lenses; frames broken by doorways... Wider lenses; Saurav physically inside activity")_ <!-- note_aec59c91ae4f -->
- [proposed] After the evening bell, the soundscape in all domestic interiors must replace exterior noise with intimate sounds like utensils, floorboards, a radio, breath, and cloth. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.26: "Utensils, floorboards, radio, breath and cloth replace exterior village sound after the bell.")_ <!-- note_cded58781526 -->
- [proposed] The setting is a fictional Indian Himalayan valley drawing from Kinnaur, Chamba, and Lahaul, avoiding the appearance of a fantasy kingdom. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.5: "culturally Indian, locally specific and never presented as a fantasy kingdom")_ <!-- note_976cff0108e3 -->
- [proposed] The season is the August monsoon, characterized by heavy clouds, softened evenings, sudden rain, wet stone, and a fast-flowing river. _(Dehleez_Devgram_Episode_One_Workbook.pdf p.5: "heavy clouds, softened evenings, sudden rain, wet stone")_ <!-- note_0d003277458b -->

hits.description: Chitkul, on the banks of Baspa River, is the first village of the Baspa Valley and the last village on the old Hindustan-Tibet trade route. It is also the last point in India one can travel to without a permit. Of particular interest at Chitkul are its houses with either slate or wooden plank roofs, a Buddhist temple and a small tower. However, there has been an increased use of tin-roofs, especially the high school and the army/ITBP barracks. The Kagyupa temple has a highly valued old image of the Shakyamuni Buddha, a Wheel of Life mandala and four Directional Kings on either side of the door
